description: Estimate building permit, plan check, sub-permit, state surcharge, school and impact fees for an ADU in a supported jurisdiction, as an itemized schedule with code citations and any waivers (for example impact fees waived under 750 sq ft). Use for "what will permits cost" questions. Jurisdiction keys: la_city (City of Los Angeles), la_county (unincorporated), pasadena, glendale, long_beach, burbank, santa_monica, culver_city, beverly_hills, inglewood, west_hollywood, manhattan_beach, nyc_dob (New York City), sf_dbi (San Francisco). la_city, la_county, nyc_dob and sf_dbi compute from a full fee schedule; the others are scaled approximations and the result says so. Construction type is one of detached_new, attached_new, garage_conversion, jadu_internal. Example: {"jurisdiction": "la_city", "construction_type": "detached_new", "square_footage": 600, "bedrooms": 1, "bathrooms": 1}.
name: estimate_permit_fees
title: Estimate ADU permit fees
